links.outcome: Seizure prediction AUC under noisy, streaming, fewer-channel, and imbalanced EEG inputs versus baseline
links.effect: AUC degrades only 2% (noisy) and 3% (streaming) on average; 32% drop with higher interictal imbalance; up to 16% with fewer channels; baseline AUC 98.56%.
links.quote: The AUC across all cross-validation sets degrades only by 2% and 3% on average for noisy and streaming data, respectively.

screen.reason: Empirical robustness evaluation of an existing deep learning seizure prediction model (SPERTL) when subjected to simulated real-world conditions like reduced channels, noise, streaming data, and class imbalance.
